items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for 25 Magento extensions, with at least one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie, affecting all versions before 1.11.12.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, stemming from a vulnerable third-party component, can be triggered remotely without authentication, causing application crashes.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, and execute unauthorized malicious code.
